description: This file contains the implementation of a controller class `OrderStatus` in the OpenCart admin module, specifically for managing order statuses within the localisation namespace. It defines methods for listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting order statuses, with associated views and model interactions. The class extends a base Controller class and includes various actions for handling HTTP requests, generating views, and processing form data.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing CRUD operations related to order statuses in the localisation namespace of the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of order statuses with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs the list of order statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of order statuses, including sorting, filtering, and pagination links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an order status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to add or update an order status, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more order statuses based on request parameters.
